DAY 0前一晚出发Setting out the night before

大阪 → 彦根，住琵琶湖边

Osaka → Hikone, a night on Lake Biwa

出发前一天 · 傍晚开车 · 约 116 km
The day before · an evening drive · about 116 km
🚗 名神高速 ~1h20🏨 蒼の湖邸 BIWAFRONT HIKONE
🚗 Meishin Expressway ~1h20🏨 Ao no Kotei BIWAFRONT HIKONE

行程

Plan

  • 大阪走名神高速到彦根，全程高速，傍晚开也方便。
  • 能在下午三四点到最好：傍晚在湖边看日落，泡露天温泉，慢慢吃晚饭。晚上七点以后才到，就改住彦根站附近的商务酒店。
  • The Meishin Expressway all the way from Osaka to Hikone — an easy drive even at dusk.
  • Best if you can arrive by mid-afternoon: watch the sun go down over the lake, soak in the open-air bath, take dinner slowly. If you can't get there before about 19:00, a business hotel by Hikone station makes more sense.

🍽 餐厅

🍽 Eating

  • 晚：酒店晚餐（含近江牛，订房时选含两餐方案）
  • 住商务酒店的话：彦根城下的 千成亭，近江牛寿喜烧、涮锅、牛排，周三休息，晚餐建议预约
  • Dinner: at the hotel, with Ōmi beef — book the half-board plan
  • If you end up in a business hotel: Sennaritei below Hikone Castle for Ōmi beef sukiyaki, shabu-shabu or steak. Closed Wednesdays; book for dinner.

🏨 住宿

🏨 Where you sleep

  • 蒼の湖邸 BIWAFRONT HIKONE——2023 年开业的湖边温泉酒店，一休评分 4.78、Yahoo!旅行 4.79（475 条评价）。普通双床房 37㎡，最多 3 人；含两餐每间约 ¥55,000–83,600；入住 15:00–20:00。订两间。官网 ↗
  • 备选：舒适酒店彦根（免费停车，小学六年级以下同床免费）/ 彦根站酒店（约 120 个免费车位）。
  • Ao no Kotei BIWAFRONT HIKONE — a lakeside hot-spring hotel opened in 2023, rated 4.78 on Ikyu and 4.79 on Yahoo! Travel (475 reviews). Standard twins are 37 m² and sleep up to three; about ¥55,000–83,600 per room with dinner and breakfast; check-in 15:00–20:00. Book two rooms. Official site ↗
  • Fallbacks: Comfort Hotel Hikone (free parking, children up to 12 share a bed free) or Hikone Station Hotel (about 120 free spaces).

DAY 1湖东三山 · 伊贺Koto Sanzan · Iga

西明寺 → 百济寺 → 伊贺 → 赤目

Saimyō-ji → Hyakusai-ji → Iga → Akame

第 1 天 · 建议工作日 · 约 131 km · 开车最多的一天
Day 1 · a weekday if possible · about 131 km · the longest drive
🚗 彦根→西明寺 ~30min🚗 百济寺→伊贺 ~1h20🚗 伊贺→赤目 ~40min🏨 对泉阁
🚗 Hikone→Saimyō-ji ~30 min🚗 Hyakusai-ji→Iga ~1h20🚗 Iga→Akame ~40 min🏨 Taisenkaku

行程

Plan

  • 9:30 出发，8:30 左右吃早饭，不用早起。
  • 10:00 西明寺：国宝本堂和三重塔，参道两边是枫树和杉林。
  • 11:15 百济寺（约 20 分钟车程）：长长的石砌参道和本坊庭园。湖东三山的第三座金刚轮寺石阶最长，孕妇同行不去。
  • 13:35 伊贺吃午饭，14:45 伊贺流忍者博物馆：机关屋、忍具和忍术表演（成人 ¥1,000，表演另收 ¥600，场次看当天）。
  • 时间够就在外面看伊贺上野城藤堂高虎修的高石垣，不进天守。傍晚开到赤目入住。
  • Leave at 9:30 after an 8:30 breakfast — no early start.
  • 10:00 Saimyō-ji: a National Treasure main hall and three-storey pagoda, with maples and cedars lining the approach.
  • 11:15 Hyakusai-ji, 20 minutes away: a long stone-paved approach and the garden of the abbot's quarters. The third temple, Kongōrin-ji, has the longest flight of steps, so skip it with a pregnant traveller.
  • 13:35 lunch in Iga, then 14:45 the Iga-ryū Ninja Museum — trick house, ninja tools and a live demonstration (¥1,000 for adults, the show ¥600 more; check the day's times).
  • If there's time, look at the towering stone walls Tōdō Takatora built for Iga Ueno Castle from outside, then drive on to Akame.

🍽 餐厅

🍽 Eating

  • 午：元祖伊贺肉 寿喜烧 金谷——百年老店，只用砂糖和酱油煮的寿喜烧，每人约 ¥8,470；11:00 开门，周一休息。孕妇的那份请煮到全熟、不蘸生蛋。
  • 周一或想吃简单点：Grill Stork，伊贺牛做的西餐（午市 11:30–14:00）。
  • 晚：对泉阁旅馆晚餐（伊贺乡土料理）
  • Lunch: Kanaya, the century-old home of Iga beef sukiyaki, cooked with nothing but sugar and soy — about ¥8,470 a head; opens 11:00, closed Mondays. Ask for the pregnant traveller's portion cooked through and skip the raw-egg dip.
  • On a Monday, or for something lighter: Grill Stork, Western-style dishes made with Iga beef (lunch 11:30–14:00).
  • Dinner: at Taisenkaku, local Iga cooking

🏨 住宿

🏨 Where you sleep

  • 赤目温泉 隐之汤 对泉阁——走到赤目瀑布步道入口约 5 分钟，免费停车约 40 个车位。新馆四楼有 2023 年翻新的和洋室（卧室和起居室分开，带露天浴池，最多 4 人），适合孕妇夫妻；12.5 张榻榻米的和室带浴厕，适合带孩子的一家。乐天订房页 ↗
  • Akame Onsen Kakurenoyu Taisenkaku — five minutes' walk from the start of the waterfall trail, about 40 free parking spaces. The new wing's fourth floor has Japanese-Western rooms renovated in 2023 (separate bedroom and sitting room, private open-air bath, up to four people) for the couple expecting a baby; the 12.5-mat Japanese rooms with their own bath suit the family with the child. Rakuten booking page ↗

DAY 2瀑布 · 古寺Falls · an old temple

赤目四十八瀑布 → 室生寺 → 吉野山

Akame 48 Falls → Murō-ji → Mt Yoshino

第 2 天 · 建议工作日 · 约 62 km
Day 2 · a weekday if possible · about 62 km
🥾 瀑布步道往返 ~2.5h🚗 赤目→室生寺 ~30min🚗 室生寺→吉野 ~1h🏨 芳雲館（2 晚）
🥾 Falls trail out and back ~2.5h🚗 Akame→Murō-ji ~30 min🚗 Murō-ji→Yoshino ~1h🏨 Hōunkan (2 nights)

行程

Plan

  • 9:00 赤目四十八瀑布：从旅馆走到入口，经不动瀑布、千手瀑布（对面有茶屋可以坐下歇脚），走到照片里的布曳瀑布再折返，不必走完整条峡谷。入口收溪谷保全费，大人 ¥1,000、中小学生 ¥500，含入口的赤目瀑布水族馆（2025 年价格）。
  • 步道有石阶和金属台阶，潮湿时容易打滑；下雨就只走到不动瀑布。
  • 13:00 室生寺：朱红太鼓桥、仁王门、金堂和杉林里的五重塔（开放 8:30–17:00）；不走通往奥之院的长石阶。
  • 14:30 出发，16:00 前后到吉野山，傍晚游客少，可以在中千本参道散步。上山前先跟旅馆确认交通管制时车怎么停。
  • 9:00 Akame 48 Falls: walk from the inn to the entrance and on past Fudō Falls and Senju Falls (there's a tea house opposite to sit down), as far as Nunobiki Falls in the photo, then turn back — no need to do the whole gorge. The gorge conservation fee is ¥1,000 for adults and ¥500 for school-age children, including the small aquarium at the gate (2025 prices).
  • The path has stone and metal steps that get slippery when wet; in rain, stop at Fudō Falls.
  • 13:00 Murō-ji: the vermilion arched bridge, the Niō gate, the Golden Hall and the five-storey pagoda in the cedars (open 8:30–17:00). Leave out the long climb to the inner sanctuary.
  • Leave at 14:30 and reach Mt Yoshino around 16:00, when the day-trippers thin out — a good hour to walk the Naka-senbon approach. Confirm with the inn how parking works under the traffic controls before you drive up.

🍽 餐厅

🍽 Eating

  • 点心：赤目入口的 たまきや，名物“へこきまんじゅう”（烤红薯馅馒头），孩子会喜欢
  • 午：室生寺门口的旅馆食堂 桥本屋，山菜套餐约 ¥2,200；营业时间出发前确认
  • 伴手礼：室生草饼本铺的艾草饼
  • 晚：芳雲館旅馆晚餐
  • A snack at Tamakiya by the Akame entrance — the local hekoki manjū, a sweet-potato bun children love
  • Lunch: Hashimotoya, the inn dining room at Murō-ji's gate, mountain-vegetable set about ¥2,200; check opening hours before you go
  • To take away: mugwort rice cakes from Murō Kusamochi Honpo
  • Dinner: at Hōunkan

🏨 住宿

🏨 Where you sleep

  • 景勝の宿 芳雲館（2 晚）——客房、大浴场和露天浴池都望得见中千本和上千本的山坡，住客评价集中在景观和安静（Google 4.3，187 条）。25 个免费车位，先到先停。带露天浴池的客房含早餐约 ¥42,600–58,800。有人遇到两个露天浴池坏了一个，订房时问一下。官网 ↗
  • 备选：竹林院群芳园（大和三名园之一，相传千利休设计，但楼梯多、设施旧）/ 吉野荘 湯川屋（紧挨金峰山寺）。
  • Keishō no Yado Hōunkan (2 nights) — rooms, the large bath and the open-air bath all look across Naka-senbon and Kami-senbon; guests mostly praise the view and the quiet (Google 4.3, 187 reviews). 25 free parking spaces, first come first served. Rooms with a private open-air bath run about ¥42,600–58,800 with breakfast. One guest found one of the two outdoor baths out of action, so ask when you book. Official site ↗
  • Alternatives: Chikurin-in Gunpōen (its garden is one of Yamato's three famous gardens, traditionally credited to Sen no Rikyū, but the building has many stairs and dated facilities) or Yoshinosō Yukawaya, right by Kinpusen-ji.

DAY 3吉野山 · 不开车Mt Yoshino · no driving

上千本 → 中千本，一路走下山

Kami-senbon down to Naka-senbon on foot

第 3 天 · 车停在旅馆 · 0 km
Day 3 · the car stays put · 0 km
🚌 山上巴士到上千本🥾 以下坡为主🏨 芳雲館第 2 晚
🚌 Mountain bus up to Kami-senbon🥾 Mostly downhill🏨 Hōunkan, second night

行程

Plan

  • 上午坐山上巴士到上千本（秋季每天运行，班次出发前查），看吉野水分神社和花矢仓观景台，从这里望得见中千本、下千本的整面山坡。
  • 顺着参道往下走，下坡多，孕妇走起来轻松一些；累了随时回旅馆。
  • 下午在中千本：竹林院群芳园（不住也能参观庭园）、吉水神社、金峰山寺藏王堂。
  • 吉野山最出名的是春天的樱花；秋天的红叶集中在中千本一带，往年 11 月上中旬较好。
  • Take the mountain bus up to Kami-senbon in the morning (it runs daily in autumn; check times on the day) for Yoshino Mikumari Shrine and the Hanayagura lookout, which takes in the whole slope of Naka- and Shimo-senbon.
  • Then walk back down the pilgrim road — mostly downhill, easier for a pregnant traveller — and head back to the inn whenever you're tired.
  • Afternoon in Naka-senbon: the Chikurin-in Gunpōen garden (open to visitors who aren't staying), Yoshimizu Shrine and the great Zaō-dō of Kinpusen-ji.
  • Yoshino is famous for spring cherry blossom; in autumn the colour gathers around Naka-senbon and usually peaks in early-to-mid November.

🍽 餐厅

🍽 Eating

  • 上午歇脚：花山的 八十吉，幕末起做吉野葛的老店，玻璃落地窗咖啡座，边看山景边吃葛切、葛饼
  • 午：中千本 豆富茶屋 林，豆腐套餐、汤豆腐套餐，孕妇也放心吃
  • 或藏王堂石阶下的 やっこ（大正年间创业，11 月不休息）：有柿叶寿司配豆皮乌冬的套餐。柿叶寿司里是腌过的生鲭鱼和三文鱼，孕妇不要吃，点乌冬就好
  • 晚：芳雲館旅馆晚餐，两晚的菜单可以请旅馆换成不同的
  • A morning break at Yasokichi in Hanayama, dealing in Yoshino kudzu since the 1860s — a glass-walled café where you eat kudzu noodles and sweets looking out over the mountain
  • Lunch: Tōfu Chaya Hayashi in Naka-senbon, tofu sets and simmered tofu — safe for everyone
  • Or Yakko at the foot of the Zaō-dō steps (since the 1910s, open every day in November): persimmon-leaf sushi with kitsune udon. The sushi is cured raw mackerel and salmon, so not for the pregnant traveller — the udon is fine.
  • Dinner: at Hōunkan — ask for a different menu on the second night

DAY 4谈山神社 · 进山Tanzan Shrine · into the mountains

谈山神社 → 洞川温泉 · 御手洗溪谷

Tanzan Shrine → Dorogawa Onsen · Mitarai Gorge

第 4 天 · 建议工作日 · 约 83 km
Day 4 · a weekday if possible · about 83 km
🚗 吉野→谈山 ~40min🚗 谈山→洞川 ~1h20（国道 309）🏨 花屋德兵卫
🚗 Yoshino→Tanzan ~40 min🚗 Tanzan→Dorogawa ~1h20 (Route 309)🏨 Hanaya Tokubei

行程

Plan

  • 9:30 从吉野山出发，往北约 40 分钟到谈山神社（开放 8:30–16:30）：十三重塔和红叶，就是照片里的回廊。主参道陡石阶可以从神社左侧停车场附近的路线绕开。
  • 11:45 出发，经国道 309 号进山。导航务必设“天川村川合”为途经点；有的导航会带去县道 48 号小南峠，那段路很窄、会车困难。下面的导航按钮已经加好了。
  • 13:10 到洞川吃午饭，14:30 御手洗溪谷：开到方便停车的路段，看翡翠色的溪水、白色岩床和两岸红叶。不要从洞川步行过去，那条步道约两小时，部分路段不平缓。
  • 傍晚逛洞川温泉街，木造旅馆一排排点着灯笼。
  • Leave Yoshino at 9:30 and drive 40 minutes north to Tanzan Shrine (open 8:30–16:30): the thirteen-storey pagoda and the maples — the photo is its lantern gallery. You can avoid the steep main stairway by the path near the car park on the shrine's left.
  • 11:45 head into the mountains on Route 309. Set Tenkawa-mura Kawai as a waypoint — some sat-navs send you over Prefectural Road 48 and the Konami pass, which is very narrow with almost nowhere to pass. The buttons below already include it.
  • Lunch in Dorogawa around 13:10, then 14:30 Mitarai Gorge: drive to a section with easy parking for the jade-green water, pale rock beds and autumn colour. Don't walk there from Dorogawa — the connecting trail takes two hours and isn't all gentle.
  • At dusk, wander the Dorogawa onsen street, its wooden inns lit by lanterns.

🍽 餐厅

🍽 Eating

  • 谈山神社一带餐厅少，可以在吉野山买点心带上车
  • 午：洞川的名水豆腐（用日本名水百选的洞川涌水做的豆腐），或夫妻经营、分量很足的中华食堂 彰武；营业时间出发前确认
  • 晚：花屋德兵卫旅馆晚餐。洞川晚上能吃饭的地方很少，一定订含晚餐的方案
  • There's little to eat around Tanzan Shrine — pick up snacks on Mt Yoshino for the car
  • Lunch: Dorogawa's spring-water tofu, made with water from one of Japan's officially listed "100 best springs", or Shōbu, a generous husband-and-wife Chinese diner; check hours before you go
  • Dinner: at Hanaya Tokubei. Almost nothing is open in Dorogawa at night, so book the plan with dinner.

🏨 住宿

🏨 Where you sleep

  • 花屋德兵卫——约五百年历史的老旅馆，过去接待去大峰山修行的人。有双床房和和洋室；“天空之间”12 张榻榻米，带卫生间、洗手台、温泉浴池和露台，适合孕妇夫妻。便宜的房间共用卫生间，订房时避开。官网客房介绍 ↗
  • 备选：角甚 / あたらしや旅館，都有带卫生间的和室，睡地铺。
  • Hanaya Tokubei — an inn of some five hundred years that used to put up pilgrims bound for Mt Ōmine. It has twins and Japanese-Western rooms; the "Tenkū" room is 12 mats with its own toilet, washbasin, hot-spring bath and deck — the one for the couple expecting. The cheaper rooms share toilets, so avoid those. Official room guide ↗
  • Alternatives: Kadojin or Atarashiya, both with Japanese rooms that have their own toilet; futons on the floor.

DAY 5返程Heading home

洞川 → 大阪

Dorogawa → Osaka

第 5 天 · 上午在洞川 · 约 91 km
Day 5 · the morning in Dorogawa · about 91 km
🚗 洞川→大阪 ~2h✈ 关西机场车程差不多
🚗 Dorogawa→Osaka ~2h✈ About the same to Kansai airport

行程

Plan

  • 上午在温泉街看龙泉寺，和修验道有关的寺，走着就到。
  • 午饭后经天川村川合、国道 309 号开回大阪。
  • 如果坐当晚 23:20 左右的新加坡航空 SQ623，可以直接开去关西机场还车，不必在大阪多住一晚；孕妇坐红眼航班比较累，要权衡。
  • A morning visit to Ryūsen-ji, the Shugendō temple in the middle of the onsen street.
  • After lunch, drive back to Osaka via Kawai and Route 309.
  • On the ~23:20 Singapore Airlines SQ623 you can drive straight to Kansai airport and drop the car, skipping a night in Osaka — but a red-eye is tiring when pregnant.

🍽 餐厅

🍽 Eating

  • 早上去买名水豆腐，人气店上午就会卖完
  • 伴手礼：洞川的老牌胃药陀罗尼助丸，温泉街上有几家老铺
  • Buy spring-water tofu early — the popular shop sells out by late morning
  • To take home: Daranisuke, Dorogawa's centuries-old herbal stomach remedy, from the old shops along the street

自驾 & 实用提示

Driving & practical notes

  • 租车：五个人加五六天的行李，订 7 座车；6 岁以下的孩子坐车必须用儿童座椅，一起订。
  • 吉野山交通管制：2026 年 10 月 24 日至 11 月 30 日视拥堵实施。按吉野町去年的公告，管制时车不能开过吉野山观光停车场（旺季一辆 ¥1,000）。订芳雲館时问清：管制时车能否开到旅馆停车场，行李怎么送。
  • 工作日：Day 1–4 尽量放在工作日。湖东三山上午十点后、吉野山傍晚上山，周末最堵。例如周日晚出发，Day 1–4 就是周一到周四——但金谷周一休息，那天改吃 Grill Stork。
  • 洞川的路：进出都设“天川村川合”为途经点，避开县道 48 号小南峠。山路只在 Day 4、Day 5 白天开。
  • 孕妇同行：每家旅馆事先说明，把生鱼、生肉、未全熟的蛋换成熟食；柿叶寿司不要吃；泡温泉按产科医生意见，避免水温过高和久泡；不做泰式按摩；查清航空公司的孕周乘机规定。
  • 订房：每晚两间。逐家确认有没有独立卫生间、有没有床、要不要爬楼梯、孩子怎么收费、最晚几点到能吃晚饭。
  • 红叶：湖东三山、赤目、室生寺、谈山神社往年 11 月中下旬最好；吉野山 11 月上中旬；洞川海拔高，10 月底到 11 月上旬最好，中旬去可能已到尾声。出发前一周看当地红叶情报。
  • 回程航班（关西 → 新加坡）：新航 SQ619 上午 10 点多、SQ621 约 16:50、SQ623 约 23:20；酷航 TR819/821 下午 15:30 前后。各来源时间不完全一致，以官网为准。
  • Car: five people and six days of luggage means a 7-seater. Children under 6 must ride in a child seat by law — book one with the car.
  • Traffic controls on Mt Yoshino: in force as congestion requires from 24 October to 30 November 2026. Under last year's notice, cars couldn't go beyond the Yoshinoyama tourist car park (¥1,000 per car in peak season). When booking Hōunkan, ask whether you can drive to their car park during the controls and how luggage gets to the inn.
  • Weekdays: try to keep Days 1–4 on weekdays — Koto Sanzan after 10:00 and the drive up Yoshino in the late afternoon are worst at weekends. Leaving on a Sunday evening makes Days 1–4 Monday to Thursday, but Kanaya is closed on Mondays, so eat at Grill Stork that day.
  • The Dorogawa road: in and out, set Tenkawa-mura Kawai as a waypoint to stay off Prefectural Road 48 over the Konami pass. Mountain driving only happens in daylight on Days 4 and 5.
  • Travelling pregnant: tell every inn in advance and ask for raw fish, raw meat and soft eggs to be swapped for cooked dishes; skip the persimmon-leaf sushi; bathe in hot springs only as the obstetrician advises, avoiding very hot water and long soaks; no Thai-style massage; check the airline's pregnancy rules.
  • Rooms: two a night. At each place confirm a private toilet, real beds, whether there are stairs, how the child is charged, and the latest arrival time for dinner.
  • Autumn colour: Koto Sanzan, Akame, Murō-ji and Tanzan Shrine usually peak in mid-to-late November; Yoshino in early-to-mid November; Dorogawa, being higher, from late October into early November, so it may be past its best in mid-month. Check local foliage reports a week before.
  • Flights home (Kansai → Singapore): Singapore Airlines SQ619 mid-morning, SQ621 around 16:50, SQ623 around 23:20; Scoot TR819/821 mid-afternoon. Sources disagree slightly — confirm on the airlines' sites.
